title: Stoker metadata — leaderboards
description: `games/<id>/leaderboards.json`: the game's leaderboards, in its own order — on Steam, the order of its leaderboard list. Definitions only — the scores are a Stoker instance's. A game creates its boards itself when it first runs, so the first caller's sort and display settings are what a board keeps; recording them here means two instances rank the same board the same way.

name.description: The name the game finds it by. Steam caps it at 128 characters.

sortMethod.description: Which end is the top: `ascending` for times, `descending` for points.
